segments: Install the three cogs, descend with a fresh Gas Mask, open the arena with the Masamune, and repeat the boss damage cycle four times.

Replace a damaged Gas Mask before the descent, bring the Masamune, and take a strong shotgun or another reliable Thrasher-killing weapon. Once you go down, play for movement and survival rather than standing still for damage.
Return to the elevator machinery, place the three recovered cogs, and activate the descent into the lower chamber.
After the elevator drops, use the Masamune on the glowing vine/spore growths blocking the path into the boss arena.
Shoot the first active spore to start the fight, then keep rotating around the arena instead of holding one position.
Use charged Masamune shots to control the ground and keep the arena manageable.
Use a shotgun or the Skull of Nan Sapwe to delete normal Thrashers when they pressure the route.
Avoid spiders and keep moving while the next boss spore becomes available.
The boss weak-point spores become available one at a time. Repeat the same survival-and-damage cycle four times to finish Seeds of Doubt.
